environment: Playwright 1.64.1 / Chromium 156.0.8078.4 headless, macOS arm64 with SwiftShader; phone is the 390 x 844 touch-emulated project at device scale 2
fixture: Disposable in-memory sandbox household ($60.00 of $300.00 at the start) with the stateful fake PayPal and no keys. Stories made through the real payment service with a fixture clock moved on between steps: $12.00 checked after it counted; $15.00 checked, then a verified $5.00 refund webhook; $18.00 refunded in full from the app; $20.00 held as pending
spec: test/e2e/receipt-breakdown.spec.mjs — each receipt says how much still counts…
steps: Load the app and open the Ledger (AG Grid)
For each story, search its PayPal order id and choose its record; open the existing Payment details disclosure
Capture the viewport with the selected record scrolled into view
